facts.text: Customer has Business Central online tenant.
At least one user has SUPER permissions in target company.
Users without SUPER permissions automatically assigned to Intelligent Cloud permission set for read-only access.
Install Intelligent Cloud Base and Business Central Intelligent Cloud extensions.
Business Central version 25.0 or later on-premises.
Change application version in database to match upgraded version during upgrade.
SQL Server 2016 SP1 or later with compatibility level 130 or higher.
Login account for SQL Server authentication must have sysadmin role at server level and db_owner role at database level.
